read:sow_coverage.how_to_decide: Compare the line with the signed or final SOW. What matters is whether the final document carries the same fact, not who said it or how it was worded.

answers.in_sow: The SOW states the same fact, possibly in other words.
answers.differs: The SOW states the fact with a different number, site or date.
answers.missing_from_sow: The fact affects the work but the SOW never states it.
